name: software-factory
description: Software Factory, a Claude Code plugin that runs a feature through spec, build, parallel reviews and approval with subagents, then shepherds the PR to green CI.

plugins.name: software-factory
plugins.description: /factory takes a feature through spec, build, parallel reviews (including test quality and accessibility) and an approver, then merges it or asks you, and fixes CI until the PR is green. Works in any repo, with a live dashboard.
